characters.description: The Beastborn founder of Brightsong and the Bravers Guild returns from a successful recovery mission with stronger abilities and altered blue eyes. He must secure the settlement while deciding how to contain the chained Draxt beneath it.
characters.name: Hal

characters.description: Hal's inner counterpart and a trusted source of counsel. While Hal rejoins the recovered allies in Brightsong, Besal remains apart to scout the Fathomways, though Hal can still sense that he remains safe.
characters.name: Besal

characters.description: A senior ally who returns safely to Brightsong with Hal's recovered group.
characters.name: Ashera

characters.description: A ranger and returning ally who reaches Brightsong safely with Hal's recovered group. She remains one of his loyal companions as the settlement faces the consequences of the rescue.
characters.name: Elora

characters.description: A returned dwarf leader and skilled builder who reaches Brightsong safely with Hal's recovered group.
characters.name: Durvin

characters.description: Brightsong's external-defense leader and Hal's partner. Noth gathers the returned party, oversees the watch on the ancient dungeon, and helps turn the settlement's urgent needs into a formal plan for leadership and protection.
characters.name: Noth

characters.description: Hal's loyal mimic companion. Vorax returns safely with the recovered party and remains close to Hal as Brightsong faces the consequences of the rescue.
characters.name: Vorax

characters.description: A surviving creature chained beneath Brightsong in the ancient dungeon. Its Perfect Rebirth leaves Hal uncertain whether the dungeon can continue to contain it.
characters.name: Draxt

characters.description: Hal's close protector, appointed treasurer as Brightsong shifts to a delegated council.
characters.name: Lurklox

characters.description: An unnamed Appa who arrives with Ashera as a Brightsong citizen and proposes building and operating an inn.
characters.name: Ashera's Appa companion

characters.description: A trainer appointed with Boko Bluefeather to organize and train Brightsong's expeditioners.
characters.name: Mira

characters.description: A ranger and scout chosen for the six-member expedition into the imprisoned dragon's dungeon.
characters.name: Angram

characters.description: A Brightsong construction leader who already knows that Durvin is an exiled king.
characters.name: Barden

characters.description: Barden's unnamed son, given independent responsibility for Brightsong's production and its unused workers.
characters.name: Barden's son

characters.description: A dwarf who already knows Durvin's concealed royal status and who lost a class during the return to Aldim.
characters.name: Athagan

characters.description: A gnome administrator who previously served as quartermaster. Rondo becomes Brightsong's head clerk when Hal creates a delegated council, taking responsibility for the settlement's growing civic workload.
characters.name: Rondo

characters.description: A realm-walking dragon who voluntarily remains imprisoned to contain his dangerous daughter. He refuses to end the threat by having her killed.
characters.name: Gold dragon

characters.description: The gold dragon's dangerous daughter, a tyrant white whose release is bound to her father's departure from his voluntary imprisonment.
characters.name: Tyrant white dragon

characters.description: A transdimensional presence manifested through the Grey Arbiter's vessel during Hal's kindred judgment. The Dream kindred recognizes the interdimensional mage and asks why it has been summoned.
characters.name: Dream kindred

characters.description: A world-shard custodian who orders Hal's mortal journey ended because his continued existence is causing dangerous errors. The Arbiter grants a kindred judgment and becomes the vessel through which the Kindred of Dream manifests.
characters.name: Grey Arbiter

characters.description: An interdimensional mage who notices dangerous instability around Aldim. He freezes the crisis inside Frostmourne and carries the unconscious Hal away.
characters.name: Interdimensional mage

characters.description: The interdimensional mage who asks the Dream kindred to examine Hal and help repair the damage to his Beastborn class.
characters.name: Mage King

characters.description: A distant founder mentioned by Ashera as an example of the geographic limits on a founder's influence.
characters.name: Rinbast

characters.description: An unnamed founder who covertly enters Rinbast's territory using a noblewoman persona and spectral servants. She is investigating a rumored challenger and may aid him against Rinbast if he proves suitable.
characters.name: Undercover illusionist

characters.description: A former mayor who works with covert allies in Merkmire and is personally known to Hal. She accepts the risk of forbidden magical travel because she can approach Brightsong without exposing the wider network behind her warning.
characters.name: Former Winstrom mayor

characters.description: A powerful Merkmire practitioner and childhood friend of the former mayor. After using forbidden scrying and transposition to help them escape, he arrives at Brightsong severely injured, useful as a possible magical ally but not yet trusted by Hal.
characters.name: Court mage

characters.description: The former Winstrom mayor's tiefling mentor, who helps direct covert work in Merkmire. He wants to check on Hal but remains behind to continue the local effort while the mayor carries its warning.
characters.name: Tiefling mentor

characters.description: Elora's unnamed familiar, confirmed alive after the recovered party returns to Brightsong.
characters.name: Elora's familiar

characters.description: A member of the returned group who did not lose a class during the journey back to Aldim.
characters.name: Buffrix

characters.description: A broadly capable Brightsong crafter who eagerly becomes Elora's familiar's brewing assistant and helps produce and seal the experimental kegs.
characters.name: Agda

characters.description: An expedition leader appointed alongside Mira to organize and train Brightsong's expeditioners.
characters.name: Boko Bluefeather

characters.description: A mage apparently tied to Rinbast's inner court who seeks passage into the Shiverglades while traveling with two suspected Kinslayers.
characters.name: Disguised expedition mage

characters.description: A senior mage serving Rinbast who has sent Kinslayers toward Hal.
characters.name: Rinbast's archmage

characters.description: A young oracle who uses rune-marked stones to stabilize Hal's fading shadowy inner counterpart while withholding her wider purpose.
characters.name: Young oracle

characters.description: A hostile figure attempting to seize control of Hal's inner counterpart from afar.
characters.name: Hostile controller

characters.description: A rival Beastborn possessing Besal and fighting him within his restored scarscape.
characters.name: Rival Beastborn

characters.description: A fading inner counterpart of Hal who is distinct from Besal. It consents to the young oracle's stabilizing procedure, becomes more solid, and is left in a state that makes remaining nearby unsafe.
characters.name: Shadowy inner counterpart
